items.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021
items.q: my teacher, Robert Hopkins at that time, at Youngstown University

ctx.x: piece, like what is the composer doing here. I mean I know in the past I’ve had little assignments where I might look at a score and go down vertically, see if I can make sense out of all the instruments. What’s the chord here?

Absolutely, yeah. That’s the way, in my Beethoven sonatas my teachers at college would laugh because I had everything labeled G7 — and they would just — they couldn’t believe it. I said if I don’t know what it is per my own understanding, you know because I could get through the theory classes and call it a 5 – 7 or whatever, but for me it was like if it was a G7 it was a G7. And I said that helps me to fake it if I have to. And I remember one particular jury I did where I was convinced I was going to flunk…
But that’s so much better than stopping, right?
